title: Notification regarding Single Bench of Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh will sit at 10:30 AM, 28 September, 2026 instead of 12:00 noon.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPH AL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 26th September, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : in partial modification of earlier notification, it is
informed to all learned members of the Bar and litigants that Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr.
Justice A. Bimol Singh will sit at 10:30 am on 28th September, 2026 (instead of 12:00 noon
as already published on 7th September, 2026).
